title: Geist Finance (Fantom) — zombie Aave V2 fork: staking-reward farm is the live E-U path; liquidations unprofitable

key_facts: E-U path: buy GEIST on SpookySwap (86.5M GEIST for 20,000 WFTM), stake(unlocked), getReward() after 1 week -> aTokens (aCRV 2.99M nominal, aMIM 6,513, aDAI 14.6, aETH 0.000026, aLINK 0.0063), redeem+sell -> 8,875 WFTM, unstake+sell GEIST -> net +8,813.8 WFTM (~$603) for one week
the aCRV redemption drains the entire 107,517 CRV cash (98% of aCRV supply sits in the staking contract) - one-time ~$344
recurring stream ~$260/week from aMIM/aDAI/aETH/aLINK interest on the treasury balances
liquidation screen: 2,421 live debtors; 905 with HF<1; 881 with HF<1 and collateral; ZERO pairs with >$1 estimated profit
largest realisable collateral positions (USDC 997,708; fUSDT 9,293; BTC 17.6) all carry WFTM debt (oracle/market ratio 1.57) which is unprofitable to repay
aToken cash ~$18.0M at frozen oracle prices but only 1,909,747 WFTM (~$110-131k) when dumped into the live SpookySwap+SpiritSwap pools
H-O split: withdrawable holders can realise ~$115k; ~$15k of cash is locked behind underwater borrowers (S)
treasury aTokens are streamed to stakers; the deployed staking contract exposes getReward() (0x3d18b912), not the array variant in the GitHub source
caveats: the ~$603 first-cycle E-U includes a one-time CRV cash drain; steady-state is ~$260/week and shrinks as the aToken cash is consumed
market prices for the unbacked Multichain tokens are thin local DEX prices; a Multichain liquidation distribution could re-rate them
CI FANTOM_RPC_URL secret non-functional; scans/tests used keyless public endpoints (rpc2/rpc3.fantom.network)
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$603 in the first week (~$260/week recurring) by buying GEIST, staking it and claiming the treasury's aToken rewards; the liquidation path is $0 (all 881 underwater positions are unprofitable); ~$115k of aToken cash is holder-withdrawable (H-O)
